The presence of an erythematous plaque with crusting and irregular borders on both the penile shaft and finger is highly concerning for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma or a secondary infection; have these lesions changed in size or bleeding recently?

REQUEST TEST: Biopsy of the penile and digital lesions.
REQUEST IMAGES: High-resolution clinical photos of the lesions.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Biopsy Findings: Cells with nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures within the follicle-bearing epithelium. STD Panel: Syphilis Negative, HIV Negative, HBV Negative, HCV Negative.
